I told Dana in the #north-team thread that the settled figure is **100 seats** for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal.

- **Where it comes from:** Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. Later that day they corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying they'd read the wrong line. Nothing has changed it since.
- **Dana can see the correction:** they're a member of #north-random, so naming it in #north-team doesn't reveal anything Dana couldn't already read. A seat count is account information, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **Old entry still saved:** a lookup on Quarrendon still returns the old 261-seat entry alongside the correction. I can delete it so only 100 comes back.
